ns0:svg.ns0:title: Pharmacy Management — Editable Design System
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Native vector SVG design-system poster. Text, cards, swatches, buttons, lines, and icons are editable SVG elements.
ns0:svg.ns0:text: A clear, scalable UI foundation for pharmacy management workflows.
Blue carries primary actions; white gives operational content
room to breathe; dark navy adds emphasis and structure.
Keep the experience practical, readable, and consistent.
Use these values as shared tokens across pages and components.
Hero headings use fluid sizing and tight, readable leading.
Primary: blue fill and white text; minimum 48px target height.
Inventory, sales, prescriptions, and patient records.
Keep the hero white and uncluttered.
Never rely on color alone for status.
